+++ buggy.sv
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@
 			begin 
 				match <= 1'b0;
 			end
-		else if (a_tem == 8'b0111_0001)
+		else if ((a_tem == 8'b0111_0001) && (a == 1'b1))
 			begin

claims.violated_requirement: The match output should only assert when the shift register contains 8'b0111_0001, regardless of the current input value. This mutation incorrectly makes the match dependent on the current input being 1'b1 when the pattern is detected.
claims.spec_basis: The spec requires match to be asserted whenever a_tem matches 8'b0111_0001, with no dependency on the current input value.

grammar_error: Syntax-token insertion/deletion is forbidden. Replace at most two existing operands/operators, or swap one existing two-operand concatenation. Do not append an if guard.
